en.headline: Two foreign tourists arrested at airport after Chai Wan MTR depot graffiti
en.dek: Police detained the pair, aged 30 and 34, in the departure hall about six hours after they allegedly cut security wiring, sprayed large murals on a stabled train and fled over a three-metre wall.
body: Police arrested two foreign male tourists at Hong Kong International Airport on Wednesday evening on suspicion of criminal damage after they allegedly broke into the MTR Chai Wan depot and spray-painted graffiti on a parked train.

Depot staff reported the incident around 2pm when they found two murals, each about one metre by five metres, on a stabled carriage and spotted two men in reflective vests nearby. The suspects fled over a three-metre perimeter wall after being noticed. Sections of anti-intrusion wiring on top of the fence had been cut.

Using closed-circuit footage including cameras under the police Project Hawkeye network, officers tracked the pair to the airport departure restricted area. They were arrested around 8pm before boarding flights to the United States and Australia. Clothing believed worn during the offence was seized from their luggage. The men, who described themselves as a renovation worker and an e-commerce manager, remain in custody for investigation. Police said criminal damage carries a maximum penalty of 10 years’ imprisonment.

zh.headline: 兩外籍男遊客闖柴灣港鐵車廠塗鴉 機場離境大堂被捕
zh.dek: 警方指兩人涉嫌剪爛圍牆防盜線潛入車廠，在停泊列車噴上約一米乘五米塗鴉後翻牆逃走，約六小時後在機場登機前落網。
body: 警方周三晚上在香港國際機場拘捕兩名外籍男遊客，涉嫌刑事毀壞。兩人被指潛入港鐵柴灣車廠，在停泊的列車上噴漆塗鴉。
事發約下午2時，車廠職員巡查時發現一列停泊列車有兩幅約一米乘五米的塗鴉，並在附近發現兩名身穿反光衣的可疑男子。疑犯被發現後即翻越三米高圍牆逃走。圍牆頂部部分防盜線被剪爛。
警方透過包括「銳眼計劃」在內的閉路電視迅速鎖定目標，同日約晚上8時在機場離境禁區，於兩人準備登機前往美國及澳洲前拘捕他們，並在行李檢獲涉案衣物。兩名疑犯分別30歲及34歲，報稱裝修工人及電子商貿經理，現正被扣留調查。警方指刑事毀壞最高可判監10年。
